title: Investigate anti-diagonal-invariant contour quantity for Chebyshev cubic
description: The Chebyshev cubic family is conjugate under (u,v)->(-v,-u), but contouring on raw kneading matrix equality remains only approximately symmetric because conjugate maps can induce relabeled kneading matrices. Investigate a contour quantity or comparison rule that is invariant under this conjugacy while preserving the intended contour structure.
close_reason: Traced the missing anti-diagonal mirror to non-finite iterate handling in kneading_matrix!: a real target branch reflects to no raw exact-label branch because NaN falls through to lap 1 and breaks the Chebyshev conjugacy in escape regions.

title: Handle non-finite iterates in kneading_matrix!
description: The Chebyshev cubic anti-diagonal asymmetry in the raw exact-label contour scan is caused by non-finite iterates. In kneading_matrix!, once an orbit overflows to Inf and then NaN, lap detection falls through to lap 1 because comparisons with NaN are false, which breaks the x -> -x conjugacy in escape regions. Update the kneading matrix builder to preserve escaped-lap/sign information for non-finite iterates and rerender the Chebyshev contour to verify the mirrored branch appears.
close_reason: Added a Chebyshev-specific kneading-matrix path that continues escaped non-finite iterates according to the correct one-sided or alternating lap behavior, switched the contour scan to use it, added regression tests, and regenerated the Chebyshev exact-label plot.
